title: Goldfish reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- fish body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='26' ry='18' fill='url(#glow)'/>
